inner_budget.description: Native TD-MPC2 actor–critic updates on frozen-model imagined transitions; each update performs critic, actor, and local-target interpolation.

tdambi_3.description: TDAMBI: three paired critic/actor updates per round.

tdambi_6.description: TDAMBI: six paired critic/actor updates per round.

tdambi_12.description: TDAMBI: twelve paired critic/actor updates per round.

update_timing.description: Interleave native paired updates with each vectorized imagined rollout step.

step_j5_c1_a1.description: Five rounds; one paired critic/actor update after every 512 imagined transitions (one vector step). H3 gives 15 updates each per decision.

step_j5_c2_a2.description: Five rounds; two paired critic/actor updates after every 512 imagined transitions (one vector step). H3 gives 30 updates each per decision.
